excerpt: LEGEND-200 started taking data in 2023 at Laboratori Nazionali del Gran Sasso (LNGS): in about one year it collected a total physics exposure of 61 kg yr ... T1/2>0.5x10^26 yr at 90% CL. A combined analysis of GERDA, MAJORANA Demonstrator and LEGEND-200 gives T1/2>1.9x10^26 yr at 90% CL.
title: First results from LEGEND-200 on the search for neutrinoless double beta decay
